purpose: Read a live coding repo about rules and when they stop, then build from it.

pages.title: isaactoslow1313/when-do-rules
pages.reaction: A rule engine that promises the same answer everywhere, which is a grand claim for a rulebook. The page reads like a brochure, though, and the words 'live coding' never appear. I was sent to read about rules and when they stop; this is the opposite, rules that never stop. Mildly amused, not moved.
